CODESTYLE.md:1:# CODESTYLE.md
CODESTYLE.md:2:
CODESTYLE.md:3:Style rules for the DETRAN monorepo. Mechanical rules are enforced by Prettier (`pnpm
CODESTYLE.md:4:format:check`), TypeScript strict mode and the `tools/*.ts` gates inside `pnpm check`; the rest
CODESTYLE.md:5:is convention that reviewers and agents enforce. Companion of `AGENTS.md` (governance) and
CODESTYLE.md:6:`docs/framework/arch/rait-build-pack.md` (what to build).
CODESTYLE.md:7:
CODESTYLE.md:8:## TypeScript
CODESTYLE.md:9:
CODESTYLE.md:10:- **Strict, ESM, TS 6.** `strict: true`; no `any` in `src` (relaxed in tests); ESM specifiers end
CODESTYLE.md:11:  in `.js` even when importing `.ts` sources; `import type` for type-only imports.
CODESTYLE.md:12:- **Prettier**: single quotes, trailing commas, 2-space indent, LF, UTF-8, 80 columns.
CODESTYLE.md:13:- **Naming**: `lowercase-hyphenated` filenames; `PascalCase` types/classes; `camelCase` values;
CODESTYLE.md:14:  `SCREAMING_SNAKE` only for canonical tokens (states, timers, events) and constants.
CODESTYLE.md:15:- **Domain vocabulary is Portuguese** and comes from the workflows: state tokens, timer codes,
CODESTYLE.md:16:  role codes, error codes and i18n keys are copied, never translated or abbreviated. Column and
CODESTYLE.md:17:  API field names are English `snake_case`/`camelCase` (as the generated modules do); enum values
CODESTYLE.md:18:  keep the canonical Portuguese token.
CODESTYLE.md:19:- No unused variables except `^_`; no `console.log` outside tools; no `Date.now()` in domain code
CODESTYLE.md:20:  (inject `Clock`).
CODESTYLE.md:21:
CODESTYLE.md:22:## Backend (NestJS, STYNX)
CODESTYLE.md:23:
CODESTYLE.md:24:- Generated modules (`Generated from BP-…` header) are **never edited**. Behaviour lives in
CODESTYLE.md:25:  `backend/domains/inf/<module>/src/handwritten/` and is exported through the blueprint's
CODESTYLE.md:26:  `handwrittenExports`.
CODESTYLE.md:27:- Command shape: one file per command with `parse` (zod), `guard` (state + role + preconditions),
CODESTYLE.md:28:  `apply` (writes inside one `Database.tx`), `events` (outbox in the same transaction). Controller
CODESTYLE.md:29:  methods only extract params and call the command.
CODESTYLE.md:30:- Decorators on every route: `@Resource('inf:rait-<resource>')`, `@Action('<verb>')`,
CODESTYLE.md:31:  `@Audit({ action: 'INF_RAIT_<RESOURCE>_<VERB>', entity: 'inf.<table>' })` on mutations
CODESTYLE.md:32:  (`verify:decorators`).
CODESTYLE.md:33:- Errors: `throw new RaitError('RAIT.<CODE>', { status, context })` — the code must exist in
CODESTYLE.md:34:  `docs/framework/arch/rait-error-catalog.md`; `context` carries ids and tokens only.
CODESTYLE.md:35:- Concurrency: `If-Match` on every command (428/412); `Idempotency-Key` on creations.
CODESTYLE.md:36:- Tenant: never in payloads; always from `RequestContext`; RLS is the last line, not the first.
CODESTYLE.md:37:- SQL: parameterized only; `snake_case`; DDL is canonical (`backend/database/ddl/NN-*.sql`,
CODESTYLE.md:38:  applied by `apply.sh`); hand-written DDL only in the `0x`/`1x` ranges; reference tables are
